rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice when “prevail” means to win or triumph.

example.english: We will prevail in this match.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 coeng4 jat1 ding6 jeng4

rows.note: Use this when one side, colour, group, or factor has the advantage or upper hand over others.

example.english: The blue team had the upper hand from the start, so it was hard for the red team to prevail.
example.traditional: 藍隊一開局就佔優勢，紅隊好難反超。
example.jyutping: laam4 deoi6 jat1 hoi1 guk6 zau6 zim3 jau1 sai3 hung4 deoi6 hou2 naan4 faan2 ciu1

rows.note: Use this for customs, styles, ideas, or practices that are widespread or current, rather than for a contest winner.

example.english: This way of drinking has begun to prevail lately; everyone seems to be doing it.
example.traditional: 呢種飲法近排好流行，周街都有人飲。
example.jyutping: ne1 zung2 jam2 faat3 gan6 paai2 hou2 lau4 hang4 zau1 gaai1 dou1 jau5 jan4 jam2
